## ARCTIC

Verified official route: https://support.arctic.de/p14-max/support

Subject: P14 Max ACFAN00287A — cable and connector mechanical dimensions

Hello ARCTIC Technical Support,

We are evaluating P14 Max ACFAN00287A for a student indoor air-filtration prototype and need to design cable routing and a protected enclosure entry without cutting or depinning the OEM connector.

We reviewed your straight-spoke 2D drawing dated 24 January 2025. Could you provide a dimensioned drawing or specifications covering:

1. Maximum connector housing envelope, including key/latch projections, and mating clearance.
2. Cable construction and outside dimensions at the intended clamping section: individual wires, flat bundle or common jacket, including tolerances.
3. Cable emergence location/orientation on the fan housing and usable lead length measured from that point.
4. Recommended minimum bend radius and acceptable strain-relief/clamping method or restrictions.
5. Which current fan revision these details apply to and whether the cable/connector geometry varies by revision.

A drawing or existing technical document would be sufficient. This is a technical information request, not an order or a request for certification of our assembly.

Thank you.

Subject: NA-SEC1 / NA-EC1 — connector and cable dimensions for enclosure routing

Hello Noctua Technical Support,

We are evaluating the 300 mm NA-EC1 extensions supplied in NA-SEC1 for a student indoor fan/filter prototype. We want to retain the original connectors and use a suitable protected cable entry and strain relief.

Your public information sheet lists cable length but we could not establish the following mechanical details. Could you provide:

1. Dimensioned maximum envelopes of both connector ends, including keys/latches, plus mating clearance.
2. Sleeve/cable outside dimensions and tolerances along the usable clamping section, and whether that section is appropriate for a split cable-entry insert.
3. Usable cable length excluding rigid connector bodies, minimum recommended bend radius, and any clamping/pull restrictions.
4. Relevant current part/revision identifiers and any variation in connector or sleeve geometry.

This is a technical drawing request only, not an order. We are not asking you to certify our custom assembly.

Thank you.
